name: Descent 3
description: Descent 3 is a singleplayer and multiplayer first-person shooter game and the third in the Descent series.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Descent 3's launcher sets the sound mixer to DirectSound instead of 'Creative EAX', so the game plays without reverb.

optional_settings.title: Set detail level to a fixed preset and LAN connection
optional_settings.reason: Descent 3 saves its detail preset and network connection type in the registry. The changes show it was set to detail setting 3, marked as configured, with a LAN connection at Fast speed.
